title: Component tests for VerdictDot, RunHeader, ComparisonHeader, and ComparisonView
description:
Create test files for the four new components using vitest + React Testing Library.

**`dashboard/frontend/components/editor/VerdictDot.test.tsx`** (13 tests)
1. Renders a `<button>` element with class `fv-verdict-dot`
2. `aria-label` contains tooltip text and status
3. `aria-pressed` is true when `selected=true`
4. `aria-pressed` is true when `compareSelected=true`
5. `aria-pressed` is false when neither selected nor compareSelected
6. Click without shift key fires `onClick`, not `onShiftClick`
7. Click with `shiftKey=true` fires `onShiftClick`, not `onClick`
8. Dot renders at 6px size when default (not selected, not latest)
9. Dot renders at 8px size when `selected=true`
10. Dot renders at 8px size when `isLatest=true`
11. Native `title` attribute matches `tooltip` prop
12. Opacity is 0.5 when not selected and not latest
13. Opacity is 1.0 when `isLatest=true`

**`dashboard/frontend/components/editor/RunHeader.test.tsx`** (5 tests)
1. Renders relative time text
2. Renders Latest link
3. Clicking Latest link fires `onBackToLatest`
4. Container has `role="status"` and `aria-live="polite"`
5. Latest link text content is correct

**`dashboard/frontend/components/editor/ComparisonHeader.test.tsx`** (6 tests)
1. Renders both timestamps
2. Renders both issue counts with arrow
3. Delta shows negative with emerald styling when issues decreased
4. Delta shows positive with red styling when issues increased
5. Delta shows zero with tertiary styling when equal
6. Container has `aria-live="polite"`

**`dashboard/frontend/components/editor/ComparisonView.test.tsx`** (10 tests)
1. Renders Removed, Unchanged, Added section headers
2. Removed section contains issues only in older audit
3. Added section contains issues only in newer audit
4. Unchanged section contains issues in both audits
5. Empty section shows "(none)" text
6. Both audits with identical issues: only Unchanged populated
7. Exit comparison link calls `onExit` on click
8. Each section has `role="group"` with correct `aria-label`
9. Finding messages longer than 65 chars are truncated
10. Removed rows have line-through text decoration

Use mock `SpeedAuditResult` objects with controlled issues for deterministic assertions.
acceptance_criteria:
- [test] VerdictDot.test.tsx has 13 passing tests covering rendering, accessibility, and click handling
- [test] RunHeader.test.tsx has 5 passing tests covering rendering, callback, and ARIA
- [test] ComparisonHeader.test.tsx has 6 passing tests covering rendering, delta colors, and ARIA
- [test] ComparisonView.test.tsx has 10 passing tests covering section grouping, empty states, and exit
- [lint] All tests use React Testing Library queries (getByRole, getByText), not implementation details
- [lint] No test imports from IntelPanel.tsx — components tested in isolation

decisions: Used container.querySelector('.vd-dot-inner') for size/opacity assertions on VerdictDot — the inner dot span has no accessible role, so direct DOM query is the right approach here.
Used screen.getByRole('status') + toHaveTextContent for ComparisonHeader timestamp/count tests — avoids the aria-hidden div complication while still verifying the content is present.
Used Unicode escape \u2212 for the MINUS SIGN in ComparisonHeader delta test to match the component's deliberate choice of U+2212 over a hyphen.
Used \u2190 (leftwards arrow) for RunHeader text content test to match the character used in the component source.
